title: Constitution of Local Councils Federally Administered Tribal Areas Regulation 1979

sections.shortTitle: Constitution of Local Councils Federally Administered Tribal Areas Regulation 1979
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

REGULATION III OF 1979
REGULATION III OF 1979
CONSTITUTION OF LOCAL
COUNCILS (FEDERALLY ADMINIS TERED TRIBAL AREAS) REGULATION, 1979
1. Short
title, extent and commencement.‑(1) This Regulation may be called the
Constitution of Local Councils (Federally Administered Tribal Areas)
Regulation, 1979.
(2) It extends to the whole of
the Federally Administered Tribal Areas.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Constitution of Local Councils Federally Administered Tribal Areas Regulation 1979
sections.description:
Definitions

REGULATION III OF 1979
REGULATION III OF 1979
CONSTITUTION OF LOCAL
COUNCILS (FEDERALLY ADMINIS TERED TRIBAL AREAS) REGULATION, 1979
2. Definitions.‑‑‑ (1) In this Regulation, unless
there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,‑
(a) "Agency" means a tribal area under the administrative
control of a Political Agent or an Additional Political Agent ;
(b) "Agency Council"
means an Agency Council constituted under this Regulation ;
(c) "Collector" means
a Political Agent, .an Additional Political Agent or a Deputy Commissioner and
includes any other officer appointed by the Agent to the President for the
purpose of discharging the functions of a Col lector under this Regulation ;
(d) "Controlling Authority" means the Agent to the
President or an officer appointed by him to exercise the powers of Controlling
Authority under this Regulation ;
(e) "Frontier Regions" means a part of the Federally
Administered Tribal Areas adjoining a District of the North‑West Frontier
Province under the administrative control of a Deputy Commissioner;
(f) "Government" means the Federal Government or the
Governor of the North‑West Frontier Province exercising executive
authority as Agent to the President ;
(g) "Local Council"
means an Agency Council, a Council for a Frontier Region or a Town Committee,
as the case may be ;
(h) "Town" means any
area declared by the Government to be a town for the purpose of this Regulation
;
(i) "Town Committee"
means a Town Committee constitute under this Regulation.

sections.shortTitle: Constitution of Local Councils Federally Administered Tribal Areas Regulation 1979
sections.description:
Local councils

REGULATION III OF 1979
REGULATION III OF 1979
CONSTITUTION OF LOCAL
COUNCILS (FEDERALLY ADMINIS TERED TRIBAL AREAS) REGULATION, 1979
3. Local Councils.‑(1) The Local Councils for the purpose of
this Regu lation shall be the following, that is to say,‑--
(a) an Agency Council for an Agency ;
(b) a Council for a Frontier
Region ; and
(c) a Town Committee for a
town.
(2) An Agency Council shall be
known by the name of the Agency, a Council for a Frontier Region by the naive
of the Frontier Region concerned and a Town Committee by the name of the town
concerned.

sections.shortTitle: Constitution of Local Councils Federally Administered Tribal Areas Regulation 1979
sections.description:
Constitution of local councils

REGULATION III OF 1979
REGULATION III
OF 1979
CONSTITUTION OF LOCAL
COUNCILS (FEDERALLY ADMINIS TERED TRIBAL AREAS) REGULATION, 1979
4. Constitution of Local Councils.‑(1) As soon as may be
after the commencement of this Regulation, the Local Councils mentioned in
section 3 shall be constituted in accordance with the provisions of this
section.
(2) The Local Councils shall
consist of such number of members as may be specified by the Government from
time to time.
(3) The members of a Local
Council shall be nominated by the Collector in consultation with the Jirgas of
the tribes living in the Agency, Frontier Region or town, as the case may be.
(4) The Collector shall ex officio be the Chairman of a Local
Council formed in an area falling within his jurisdiction.
(5) Every Local Council shall
be a body corporate having perpe tual succession and common seal, with power,
subject to the provisions of this Regulation and the rules made thereunder, to
acquire and hold property, both movable and immovable, and shall by its name
sue and be sued.

Functions of a local council

REGULATION III OF 1979
REGULATION III OF 1979
CONSTITUTION OF LOCAL
COUNCILS (FEDERALLY ADMINIS TERED TRIBAL AREAS) REGULATION, 1979
5. Functions of a Local Council.‑(1) An Agency Council and a
Council for a Frontier Region shall be responsible for the functions connected
with rural development programmes enumerated in the First Schedule.
(2) Government may assign such
other functions to an Agency Council or the Council for a Frontier Region as it
may consider necessary.
(3) A Town Committee shall be
responsible for the functions enumerated in the Second Schedule.

6. Taxes to be
levied.‑A Local Council may levy such taxes and for such purposes as may be specified
by Government.

8. Controlling Authority to
control Local Councils.‑ The
Controlling Authority shah exercise control over the working of the Local

9. Delegation of powers.‑‑The
Government may, by notification, delegate all or any of its powers under this
Regulation to a Local Council.
